Project-owned override: Arc's package-graph specs pack Release outputs with --no-build --no-restore.
The preceding Debug build restores net10.0 only. Prepare the Release package graph immediately before specs, as package-graph-verification.yml does.
Keep every Debug spec enabled and propagate any prerequisite or test failure.
Arc's root package.json only orchestrates workspaces; lint:ci and compile scripts live in each published package under Source/JavaScript.

The frontend gates run each package in turn and fail when any package fails. Each package tsconfig includes its specs, so frontend-compile also compiles specs; tsc -b is used because project references cannot disable emit, and its output goes to the ignored dist folders.

gates.description: Prepare Release package outputs, then run all Debug specs — zero failures
command: set -euo pipefail; dotnet build Source/DotNET/Cratis/Cratis.csproj --configuration Release; dotnet build Source/DotNET/Cratis.CodeAnalysis/Cratis.CodeAnalysis.csproj --configuration Release; dotnet test --configuration Debug --no-build

gates.description: yarn lint:ci in every published package — zero errors
command: set -uo pipefail; failed=0; count=0; for package in Arc Arc.React Arc.React.MVVM Arc.Vite; do count=$((count + 1)); echo "== Source/JavaScript/$package"; (cd "Source/JavaScript/$package" && yarn lint:ci) || { echo "FAILED: Source/JavaScript/$package"; failed=1; }; done; echo "Checked $count packages"; exit $failed

gates.description: tsc -b in every published package, specs included — zero errors
command: set -uo pipefail; failed=0; count=0; for package in Arc Arc.React Arc.React.MVVM Arc.Vite; do count=$((count + 1)); echo "== Source/JavaScript/$package"; (cd "Source/JavaScript/$package" && yarn run -T tsc -b) || { echo "FAILED: Source/JavaScript/$package"; failed=1; }; done; echo "Checked $count packages"; exit $failed

gates.description: Covered by frontend-compile: each package tsconfig includes its specs
